scope: A complete ten-replication restart with an explicit simulator-failure boundary. Conditional on the fixed A1 checkpoint and specialist bank, not full-pipeline multi-seed RL. Every v3 model is retained as diagnostic pilot evidence and excluded from v4 primary analysis, regardless of outcome.
unit: Student/collection replication; not individual episode or independently retrained teacher bank.

primary.assumptions: Approximately normal independent replication differences; the seed count is not a power guarantee.
primary.claim: Evidence of a positive average adaptive-recipe effect over schedule-matched offline under the common simulator-failure boundary, conditional on this BC start and teacher bank; show task-specific harms.

key_secondary.assumptions: Approximately normal independent replication differences; the seed count is not a power guarantee.
key_secondary.claim: Secondary evidence of improvement beyond these monitor-selected long-BC candidates; not proof RL is necessary.

key_secondary_status: Exploratory; interval unadjusted for multiple comparisons

simulator_policy.step_failure: Any native MuJoCo warning counter, simulator time reversal/nonfinite time, or nonfinite observation/reward ends the current episode immediately as unsuccessful and truncated. Nonfinite policy actions abort the job.
simulator_policy.retention: Retain valid pre-fault teacher labels, including the query preceding a fault. Mark the faulting chunk, log context/seed/control-step/native warning details, and acquire no further observation under that episode ID. Start a fresh explicit reset for any remaining collection budget.
simulator_policy.evaluation: Apply the identical boundary to all students, BC controls and teacher references. Faulting active episodes count as failures in the original denominator; never drop or replace them. Completed vector slots are inert until the next explicit reset.
simulator_policy.physics: Do not change MuJoCo timestep, solver, damping, controller gains, action clipping, or native auto-reset flags. Detect the native event and impose an explicit episode boundary.
simulator_policy.v3_disposition: Exclude all v3 models and data from v4 primary/secondary averages, not only seed102. No checkpoint or dataset reuse across versions. Reusing the predeclared seed numbers is not a replacement-seed search; run each v4 condition once unless an externally interrupted attempt is explicitly retried.

interpretation: Report all seeds and both tasks. Secondary contrasts are exploratory; an interval crossing zero is not equivalence. Reset pairing does not imply identical action noise.

publication_path_adapter.change: Resolve existing publication symlinks before the unchanged artifact validator; no statistical calculations changed.
